items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We played the Royal Theatre in Baltimore. We followed Benny Carter and Nat Cole into the Royal Theatre.

ctx.x: Yeah, he wanted me with the band. The guys wanted me with the band. And I was young and full of fire, and could play and read the music and everything, you know. So I was an asset to him. Like, he had another star to go Melvin to help carry the weight. You know, he had some fine players, but nobody really outstanding in the band as far as solos were concerned. So that was the situation with him.

So we did eventually get to Baltimore. We played the Royal Theatre in Baltimore. We followed Benny Carter and Nat Cole into the Royal Theatre. We were with the Charioteers, the fine vocal group, one of the fine vocal groups during that period -- and that was nice.
How long did it take to get to Baltimore?
